profile_text.body:
Hugging Face is a for-profit startup founded in 2016 and headquartered in New York, NY. The company describes itself as working to advance and democratize artificial intelligence through open source and open science, and positions itself as a community platform for AI development.

The company's primary products are the Hugging Face Hub, a repository where developers can discover, share, and deploy machine learning models, and Hugging Face Transformers, an open-source library for model hosting and inference. Both are considered relevant to AI supply-chain tracking and AI bill of materials (AIBOM) practices, with the Transformers library also associated with model card verification and security scanning.

Hugging Face also maintains an MCP server, listed as co.huggingface/hf-mcp-server, which is described as providing connectivity to the Hugging Face Hub and a range of Gradio AI applications. No litigation or SEC filings are recorded in the held facts.
